title: Dry Cargo Voyage Charter

detail_text: 1. Action Code: Presolicitation 2. Date: 26 February 2026 3. Fiscal Year: 2026 4. Contracting Office Zip Code: 23511 5. Subject: Dry Cargo Voyage Charter 8. Proposed Solicitation Number: N3220526R6056 9. Closing Response Date : 04 March 2026 10. Contract Point or Contracting Officer: David Hamilton; david.k.hamilton19.civ@us.navy.mil 11. Contract Award and Solicitation Number: T.B.D. 12. Contract Award Dollar Amount: T.B.D. 13. Contract Line Item Number: N/A 14. Contract Award Date: T.B.A. 15. Contractor: T.B.D. 16. Description: U.S. Transportation Command requires one, U.S. or foreign flag, roll-on/roll-off vessel with 20 feet or more stern ramp door and main deck height, capable of carrying 39,716 SQFT of cargo (Helicopters, wheeled vehicles and breakbulk). 17. Place of Contract Performance: The load port(s)/place(s) is Corpus Christi, TX (USA) with an available load date of 17 April 2026, and the discharge port(s)/place(s) is Alexandroupolis, Greece, latest arrival date (LAD) of 14 May 2026. The layday commences and cancels on 16 April 2026, and the period of performance will be one voyage. 18. Set-aside Status: Full and Open competition. The decision to release this solicitation as Full and Open competition is based on responses received from a recent, sources sought notice for this service. The Director of MSC’s Office of Small Business Programs has concurred with this decision.
